description: Two rows of white leather armchairs on a carpeted step behind a sheet of glass, level with first base. Each chair has a cup holder in its arm and a brass number on its back. The field is right there, and you can hear the crowd through the glass. The lounge is south.

window.description: One sheet of glass from the floor to the ceiling, over first base. The infield is close enough to read the bags.
window.name: the box glass

sections.name: The Platinum Box
sections.note: your own chair behind the glass
